page.overview:
Who is Rich Mixon?

Rich is a next-generation racer sponsored by Tank Coat that wears the number 36. After the race at Los Angeles International Speedway, he replaces Reb Meeker, the previous Tank Coat racer.

Rich is an unlockable playable character in Cars 3: Driven to Win. He is unlocked by completing 85 skill checks.
